title: Partition-fiber sign flip
statement: Given natural numbers $n,m$, a sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, a map $\pi:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and an index $j\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, define a new sign vector by reversing $x_i$ when $\pi(i)=j$ and leaving it unchanged otherwise.
